script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl55_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("58-1");
		    if dialog.show("Level55-1", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("61-1");
			if dialog.show("Level55-2", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level55-3", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level55-4", facePutong) ==1 then break end
		    if dialog.show("Level55-5", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level55-6", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("60-2");
			if dialog.show("Level55-7", facePutong) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl55_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
